name: blender-vse
description: Local, revision-safe control of editable Blender VSE projects through one Skill and four MCP tools.

interface.shortDescription: Revision-safe local Blender VSE editing for agents
interface.longDescription: Let AI agents safely inspect, edit, resume, render, and verify persistence for local Blender VSE projects. Fresh observations, atomic patches, stale-base protection, and fresh-process verification preserve human changes while the .blend remains editable.
defaultPrompt: Inspect this named .blend VSE project and summarize its editable timeline.
Apply these edits without silently overwriting human changes.
Continue this Blender VSE project from a fresh observation and verify persistence.
